units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 787">Yalk. Num. 787</cite> <he>הכהו בגוש … או בפ׳ של דבילה</he> if he killed a man with a lump of salt or a slice of a fig-cake.—Pl. <he>פְּלָחוֹת</he>, constr. <he>פִּלְחֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 5:5">Dem. V, 5</cite> <he>פ׳ דבלה</he> slices of &c. Yalk. l. c. <he>שיכו אותו … ובפ׳</he> that they may kill him (the murderer) with stones, arrows or millstones.—V. <cite ref="Q01070"><he>פֶּלֶךְ</he></cite>.
